title: Bacterial and archaeal 16S rRNA sequencing of semi-continuous anaerobic digestion treating tetracycline wastewater with S-nZVI
description: This project presents high-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing data of bacterial and archaeal communities in semi-continuous anaerobic digestion systems treating tetracycline-containing wastewater with S-nZVI. The data were generated to investigate microbial community dynamics under different operational conditions. Samples with the suffix "A" in their names correspond to archaeal community sequencing data.
